metadata.ex_date_rule: Where only a record date is published, the ex-date is derived: one business day before the record date while US settlement was T+2 (before 2024-05-28), and equal to the record date under T+1 (from 2024-05-28). For stock splits paid as a stock dividend, the ex-date is the first session after distribution.

NVDA-8K-2021-05-21.title: NVIDIA Announces Four-for-One Stock Split, Pending Stockholder Approval at Annual Meeting Set for June 3
NVDA-8K-2021-05-21.quote: a four-for-one split of NVIDIA's common stock in the form of a stock dividend ... to be distributed after the close of trading on July 19, 2021 ... Trading is expected to begin on a stock split-adjusted basis on July 20.

NVDA-8K-2021-05-26.title: NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for First Quarter Fiscal 2022
NVDA-8K-2021-05-26.quote: NVIDIA will pay its next quarterly cash dividend of $0.16 per share on July 1, 2021, to all shareholders of record on June 10, 2021.

NVDA-8K-2024-02-21.title: NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Fourth Quarter and Fiscal 2024
NVDA-8K-2024-02-21.quote: NVIDIA will pay its next quarterly cash dividend of $0.04 per share on March 27, 2024, to all shareholders of record on March 6, 2024.

NVDA-8K-2024-05-22.title: NVIDIA Corporation Form 8-K (ten-for-one forward stock split; dividend increase)
NVDA-8K-2024-05-22.quote: a ten-for-one forward stock split ... nine additional shares of common stock, to be distributed after the close of market on Friday, June 7, 2024. Trading is expected to commence on a split-adjusted basis at market open on Monday, June 10, 2024. ... increased its quarterly cash dividend by 150 percent from $0.04 per share to $0.10 per share ... equivalent to $0.01 per share on a post-Stock Split basis ... to all shareholders of record on Tuesday, June 11, 2024 ... will be paid on Friday, June 28, 2024.

NVDA-10Q-2026-04-26.title: NVIDIA Corporation Form 10-Q for the quarter ended April 26, 2026
NVDA-10Q-2026-04-26.quote: On May 18, 2026, we increased our quarterly cash dividend from $0.01 per share to $0.25 per share to all shareholders of record on June 4, 2026. Our quarterly cash dividend will be paid on June 26, 2026.
